title: Public Domain Cover
short_description: The challenge for this round is to make a cover of a song in the public domain.
long_description: Do you like classical music?  Or do you like a song in the public domain?  Your challenge for this round is to **make a cover of any song of your choice in the public domain**.  Your cover can be of any style.  You can also mishmash multiple songs into one as long as they are all in the public domain.  Any plugin and any DAW are allowed as long as they are **free and open source**.  Additionally, audio recordings such as instrumental or vocal performances are allowed.
